question: Makar Sankranti is celebrated as Pedda Panduga in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pedda Panduga **is a major festival celebrated in **Andhra Pradesh**, particularly in rural areas.
 
• It marks the **transition of the sun into the zodiac sign of Capricorn **(Makara Rasi) and the **beginning of longer days**.
 
• People **fly kites, organize cultural events, **and participate in traditional sports like bullock cart races and cockfights.</str
